What we can do: Boost FAIR data adoption

At Data Steward Team, we started the FAIR Data Clinic where researchers get personalised advice on how to make their data more FAIR.

What you can do

Please feel free to reach out to the Data Steward team. We can give presentations about FAIR data and repositories.
